title: test(ui-e2e): delete the vacuous MSW worker test and the unused msw declarations
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DX3GDGkbVgX1bfDK2kArSWv)_

Part of #25914 — the in-scope half (triage 2026-10-24: "delete the vacuous MSW test"). The card stays open for the items left to the maintainer, listed at the end.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

Re-measured on `main` 88531fab:

- `ui/apps/console/public/mockServiceWorker.js` does not exist, so `ui/e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts` "should include the MSW service worker in the build output" always took its silent `return` (SPA fallback served `text/html`) and asserted nothing. **Deleted.**
- objectui#13453 did not retire `msw`: it was still declared in `ui/package.json` (devDependency plus the `"msw": { "workerDirectory": ["public"] }` block), `ui/packages/plugin-form` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid` (devDependencies). `git grep` for `'msw'`, `msw/*`, `setupServer`, `setupWorker` outside the lockfile finds no importer in code; the only hit is the example snippet in `ui/skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`, which is consumer guidance and imports nothing here. **Removed**, together with the generated worker `ui/public/mockServiceWorker.js` that the `workerDirectory` block produced and the console `.gitignore` entry for a worker nothing generates any more.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated with `pnpm install --lockfile-only`: the three importer entries go; `msw@2.15.0` stays in the lock as an optional peer of another package, so its transitive entries flip to `optional: true` rather than disappearing.

## Verification (head d1dc66cd)

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 42 families; `--ran` reconciliation: 42 derived, 38 run (all exit 0), 4 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, need whole-tree `dist/`: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`), 0 UNRUN. CI's Build/Lint lanes own those four.
- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` against the new lock: exit 0.
- e2e test list (there is no e2e completeness gate; `check-test-completeness` reads vitest logs only): `playwright test --list --project=chromium` → 77 tests in 12 files (one fewer than `main`); `console-rendering.spec.ts` lists its remaining 3 tests.
- `check:commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` green.
- No changeset: only devDependencies and test/config files change; nothing in any package's published output moves.

## Left for a maintainer ruling (out of scope here)

- Making the 4-spec live allowlist (`test:e2e:live:ci`) a required check — a new gate.
- Moving the informational live lane (`live-e2e.yml`) from every PR to daily only — a governed workflow change.
- Triage of the 18 live specs that run in no CI (objectui#13104's list is the starting point).

## Noticed, not changed

- `ui/apps/console/vercel.json` still excludes `mockServiceWorker.js` from its SPA rewrite; harmless, left as deploy config.
- `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` still tells contributors to start a mock API with `@objectstack/plugin-msw`, which `docs/upgrading-to-11.md` says was removed.
- `console-rendering.spec.ts`'s console-error filter still ignores `MSW` / `mockServiceWorker` messages; inert, left alone.
